headline: Revenue growth accelerates while margins narrow
summary_short: CDW reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $6,572.2M, up 10.0% y/y, and diluted EPS of $2.15, up 4.9% y/y; gross margin narrowed to 20.1% from 20.8% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue was $6,572.2M, up 10.0% y/y and 15.7% q/q. Gross margin was 20.1%, down from 20.8% y/y and 21.0% q/q; operating margin was 6.5%, down from 7.0% y/y. Diluted EPS rose to $2.15, up 4.9% y/y and 18.1% q/q. Net income grew 1.2% y/y to $274.4M, up 16.6% q/q. Total cash fell to $361.8M, down 24.8% y/y and 37.5% q/q.
